metadata.portion_policy: Packaged defaults are pinned to the manufacturer label's gram serving returned by Open Food Facts. Generic defaults use an actual USDA household measure and its gramWeight. Missing, volume-only, or changed portions fail validation instead of being guessed. Each row below documents why its selected measure is useful to a person logging that item.

open_food_facts.name: Nutella Biscuits
open_food_facts.portion_reason: The package contains 22 biscuits in 304 g and Open Food Facts reports a 13.8 g label serving, so one biscuit is the natural adjustment unit.

open_food_facts.name: Simply Asia Thai Peanut Noodle Kit
open_food_facts.portion_reason: The manufacturer serving is one-third of the package (52 g), which is more recognizable than an unlabelled gram amount.

open_food_facts.name: Snickers Bar
open_food_facts.portion_reason: The product is sold as a bar and the manufacturer label serving is 50 g.

open_food_facts.name: Bjorg Fruit Muesli
open_food_facts.portion_reason: A bowl is the normal logging unit for muesli and the manufacturer label serving is 60 g.

open_food_facts.name: Barilla Pesto alla Genovese
open_food_facts.portion_reason: Pesto spoon measures vary, so the manufacturer label's 47.5 g serving is retained without an invented spoon conversion.

open_food_facts.name: Nestle Chocapic Cereal
open_food_facts.portion_reason: A bowl is the normal logging unit for cereal and the manufacturer label serving is 30 g.

open_food_facts.name: Ritter Sport Marzipan Chocolate
open_food_facts.portion_reason: Open Food Facts reports the manufacturer serving as one cube weighing 6.52 g.

open_food_facts.name: Oreo Original
open_food_facts.portion_reason: One biscuit is the natural adjustment unit and the manufacturer label serving is 11 g.

usda_fdc.name: Edamame, prepared
usda_fdc.portion_reason: A prepared cup is the standard household measure for shelled edamame; its gram weight is taken from the pinned FDC record.

usda_fdc.name: Greek yogurt, plain, nonfat
usda_fdc.portion_reason: The pinned generic FDC record defines one container as 170 g, a familiar single-serve yogurt portion.

usda_fdc.name: Blueberries, raw
usda_fdc.portion_reason: A cup is a common household serving for berries and the gram weight is read from FDC.

usda_fdc.name: Tofu, raw, firm
usda_fdc.portion_reason: FDC defines this household portion as one-quarter block; its precise gram weight is used instead of guessing a piece size.
